title: Downloading through a signed system binary
prerequisites: a Windows host where the binary is present and not blocked by policy
egress from the host to a host you control
excerpt: Windows ships signed binaries that perform network fetches or cache remote content. On an authorised host, such a binary can answer whether egress is filtered by policy rather than by network, because the traffic is attributed to a signed system process. Prefer a fetch to a host you control and record the arrival; do not leave cached files behind.
